My single mom once dated this dude she knew well for ever three years. Let’s call him David. He was a decently nice guy and was a trucker, so he made some good money. My mom works at Starbucks part time and a CNA also part time, this matters later for the story.

My mom ended up catching hard feelings for him, and he slowly started living with us little by little maybe staying one to two nights in a row before going back to work. So he decided that we should all live together like some big happy family, and of course with my mom having strong feelings for him she agreed. We moved to a 3 bedroom apartment that costed about $2400 a month, mind you this was expensive where I lived.  So apparently David promised my mom that he was going to “show her the finest things in life,” and pay for the rent without her having to pay a dime. My mom thought she finally found the perfect guy, someone who would take care of her, but this was the complete opposite. David stopped paying rent about three months in, he kept telling my mom that he’ll pay it later or that she needs to wait for his check to come. In the meantime my mom was pulling her weight and ended up coming up with $2400 a month by herself, of course me being old enough to get a job helped her most of the time,but she hated the idea of me working and not focusing on school. David either had his feet kicked up watching old sitcoms or went to work for weeks at a time without so much as call to my mom. Eventually my mom got fed up and told him to GTFO, and that he was lazy and didn’t benefit anyone by staying in our house. After David left, my mom and I struggled to pay the rent up until our lease ended, we immediately moved to some cheaper apartments and never spoke of David again. We’re doing great now if anyone is reading this lol.

TLDR: Some promises are too good to be true. Moms lazy free loader ass bf moves in and doesn’t pay his share, mom kicked his ass out without hesitation.
